## About
Jake Auto Parts and repair is a used auto parts store at 19430 Mt Elliott St in Detroit. Our inventory is kept in a management system and updated daily, so we can tell you what we have.
If the part you need isn't on our shelves, give us a call or send an email and we'll go looking for it. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating from 68 Google reviews.

## Services
- Used auto parts: Quality used parts, tracked in an inventory system that's updated daily.
- Help finding a part: Don't see the part you need? Call or email us and we'll find it for you.

## FAQ
Q: Do your mechanical parts come with a warranty?
A: Mechanical parts come with a 60-day warranty. There is no labor warranty.

Q: How are electrical and body parts sold?
A: Electrical and body parts are sold as-is.

Q: Do you ship parts?
A: Give us a call and we can talk through shipping for your part.
